officialRules: https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf pp60/63/94–97; printed AT-AT Cannon and Golan Laser Battery
scope: Normal cannon and artillery firing, adjacent battle targeting, powering and shared user weapon allowances.
method: Six actual GEMP AT-AT Cannon shots: character, vehicle and landed starfighter at same and adjacent sites.
Two actual Golan shots: same-site generator power and adjacent-site power droid. One power-source location query observation.

Native comparisons match hit, two-Force cost, user participation, base defense and post-shot firing restrictions. Native-only checks cover creature attacks, artillery forfeiture, cancellation, removed/returned targets and corrupted continuations.
limitations: Full engine remains unfinished and production deck admission is closed. No standalone study added. These component boards do not certify full matches.
Power-droid and Portable Fusion Generator cards provide metadata for powering fixtures; their other card text, deployment and effects remain required.
Other artillery, artillery remotes, movement permissions, other heavy weapons, targeting immunity/redirection, and general destruction providers remain required.

GEMP rows do not exercise creature shots, forfeiture, cancellations or source/target departure; these are native-only checks. Fixtures use controlled cancellation/state interventions rather than implemented cancellation cards.

Target-type modifiers are sampled before the total response window. Recomputing continuous modifiers if their source leaves during that later window remains required; pinned GEMP DrawDestinyEffect re-queries its final total after responses. These unchanged-source observations do not establish that interaction.
